// ABOUT: Complete reference configuration for Claude Code settings.json
// DOCS: See README.md for detailed documentation of each option
// MODEL: The model for responses. An alias (opus|sonnet|haiku|fable) tracks the current generation and will not go stale; on the Anthropic API as of Aug 2026 sonnet=Sonnet 5, opus=Opus 5. Pin a full ID (e.g. claude-sonnet-5) only when a generation is required; omit to inherit Claude Code's default.
// PERMISSIONS: Controls what Claude can do automatically vs needs to ask

permissions.// ALLOW: Operations Claude can perform without asking
permissions.// DENY: Operations that are never allowed (defense-in-depth, not a sandbox)
permissions.// DENY_NOTE: Patterns are simple matchers — easily defeated by alternate flags (rm -r -f), absolute paths (/bin/rm), long flags (rm --recursive --force), or different binaries. Pair with the sandbox.* config and protect-sensitive-files.py hook for real isolation.
permissions.// DEFAULT_MODE: Options: default (shown as 'Manual', accepts 'manual' alias in v2.1.200+), acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions

sandbox.// ENABLED: Enable sandboxed execution of bash commands
sandbox.// AUTO_ALLOW_BASH: Skip permission prompts for sandboxed bash commands
sandbox.// EXCLUDED_COMMANDS: Commands that run outside the sandbox
sandbox.// NETWORK: No domains are pre-allowed; first access to a new domain prompts. Pre-allow with allowedDomains, or set strictAllowlist:true to deny non-allowlisted hosts without prompting (v2.1.219+, user/managed settings only).

PostToolUse.// DESCRIPTION: Format JS/TS files after edit (matcher is the tool name; the command guards on extension)

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.py) black "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
osascript -e 'display notification "Task completed" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null || true

// CLEANUP_PERIOD_DAYS: Days before cleaning up old session data
